messages:
janet_acme: Hey team — finished the Acme Corp onboarding flow. Console says "API credentials created" but when I open the acme-prod project there are no API keys listed. I do see a key under a different org called "redwood-partner". Can someone confirm where the key landed? :confused:

maria: thanks for flagging, janet. can you DM a screenshot of the console project view? also paste the tenant id if you have it.

janet_acme: screenshot sent in DM. tenant id: t-acme-7782. project id: acme-prod-01. UI showed success toast after provisioning.

support_bot: [provisioner] api-key provisioning event: status=SUCCEEDED, tenant=t-acme-7782, project=partner-proxy-224, key_id=k_7f9b2e. request_id=prv-9832

aj: looks like the async provisioner created the key but bound it to partner-proxy-224 instead of acme-prod-01. possible repro: claim routing matched partner mapping. tagging @ops_jordan to inspect routing rules.

ops_jordan: on it. pulling logs now. can you confirm whether this customer used SSO or invited users through partner portal during signup? that might pick partner mapping.

janet_acme: they used the standard OIDC flow, no partner portal. signup email was janet@acme.com.

ops_jordan: k. i see a routing entry that prefers partner accounts when the provisioning job originates from ephemeral worker pool id w-ephem-9. worker id was used by our marketplace connector last week — looks like a mapping rule was accidentally set to override tenant for jobs from that pool.

maria: timeline for fix? customer is blocked from integrating. they have an internal rollout tomorrow.

ops_jordan: quick remediation plan: 1) create a new API key k_temp_2325 in acme-prod-01 and mark it active, 2) update tenant mapping to prevent future misbinds, 3) run a reconciliation to find other misbound keys created by w-ephem-9 in last 24h. i'll post commands.

ops_jordan: command to create scoped key for tenant: ```
POST /v1/internal/keys
{
  "tenant_id": "t-acme-7782",
  "project_id": "acme-prod-01",
  "display_name": "onboard-temp-janet",
  "scopes": ["inference:invoke"]
}
```

sre_li: i'll run the reconciliation job and prepare a rollback if any keys were used. also recommend rotating k_7f9b2e if it was issued to the wrong org.

maria: please include the customer in updates, janet — sending ETA: temp key created in ~15m, full reconciliation in ~2h. :thumbsup: 

janet_acme: thanks all — appreciate the fast turnaround. please confirm once temp key is live and I'll test.

ops_jordan: temp key created: k_temp_2325 (activated). please test, janet. reconciliation kickoff logged as job rek-44321. will DM results.

janet_acme: verified — temp key works for curl generate requests. thanks.

maria: closing loop: root cause = provisioning routing rule tied to ephemeral worker pool (w-ephem-9) that matched partner account mapping. mitigation: removed override, added integration test for provisioning path, and queued alert if future creations by that pool bind outside originating tenant. documented in internal runbook.

sre_li: rotated misbound key k_7f9b2e and flagged it as compromised. created follow-up ticket INT-1147 for audit and expanded reconciliation window.

janet_acme: great, thanks everyone. leaving positive note for your CS team. :sparkles:
